# `ingress.interval_s` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `300` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | ingress |
| Unit | s |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `ingress.interval_s` only if you observe problems with the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[ingress]
interval_s = 300
```

pq snapshot describe (cli, PaderQueue 4.x)
# `pq snapshot describe`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Describes a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot describe <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--since` | Only consider objects created after this timestamp (ISO 8601). |
| `--wait` | Block until the operation is completed on all nodes. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |
| `--tenant` | Name of the tenant the command applies to. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot describe orders --since
```

# Runbook: snapshotter troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `snapshotter` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_snapshotter_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `snapshotter.batch_size`
- `snapshotter.buffer_bytes`
- `snapshotter.max_retries`
- `snapshotter.max_connections`
- `snapshotter.queue_capacity`
- `snapshotter.enabled`
- `snapshotter.threshold_percent`
- `snapshotter.log_level`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

PaderQueue 2.0 release notes (changelog, PaderQueue 2.0)
# PaderQueue 2.0 release notes

Released on 2022-04-11.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## New features
- New option `compactor.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `partitioner.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, in bytes.
- New error code PQ-E2051 (COMPACTOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New option `acktracker.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `spool.compression`: compression codec that the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments uses for stored or transferred data.
- New error code PQ-E3575 (COORDINATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4426 (SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

PQ-E4712 SNAPSHOTTER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL (error, PaderQueue 4.x)
# PQ-E4712 SNAPSHOTTER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `snapshotter: work queue full`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
The internal work queue of the snapshotter is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `snapshotter.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `snapshotter: component disabled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
A request needed the snapshotter, but the snapshotter is switched off.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `snapshotter.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

PQ-E4708 SCHEDULER_THROTTLED (error, PaderQueue 4.x)
# PQ-E4708 SCHEDULER_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: throttled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `scheduler.threshold_percent`.

# PQ-E2051 COMPACTOR_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the compactor use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Set `compactor.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features
- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.
- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `snapshotter.enabled`: turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.
- New option `auth.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the authentication module that validates client tokens waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.
- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

PQ-E4712 SNAPSHOTTER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL (error, PaderQueue 4.x)
# PQ-E4712 SNAPSHOTTER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `snapshotter: work queue full`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
The internal work queue of the snapshotter is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `snapshotter.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# Postmortem INC-2024-183: checkout-service degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 12 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `checkout-service`

## Summary
During the incident, `checkout-service` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4663 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `checkout-service` fired.
- T+3: On-call engineer found PQ-E4663 in the broker logs.
- T+6: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+12: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a failing disk on one node.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4663.
- Add an alert for this error code.

# Postmortem INC-2025-114: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 55 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2602 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+13: On-call engineer found PQ-E2602 in the broker logs.
- T+27: The team temporarily moved traffic to the secondary cluster.
- T+55: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2602.
- Add an alert for this error code.
PQ-E2602 COORDINATOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL (error, PaderQueue 4.x)
# PQ-E2602 COORDINATOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The internal work queue of the coordinator is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `coordinator.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# `snapshotter.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | snapshotter |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `snapshotter.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
max_retries = 8
```

spool.batch_size (config, PaderQueue 4.x)
# `spool.batch_size`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of messages the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `100` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | spool |
| Unit | messages |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `spool.batch_size` only if you observe problems with the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
batch_size = 100
```

# Runbook: spool troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `spool` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_spool_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `spool.max_connections`
- `spool.max_retries`
- `spool.enabled`
- `spool.compression`
- `spool.threshold_percent`
- `spool.batch_size`
- `spool.log_level`
- `spool.interval_s`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

- Too small limits for the current load

PaderQueue 3.1 release notes (changelog, PaderQueue 3.1)
# PaderQueue 3.1 release notes

Released on 2024-01-15.

## New features
- New option `acktracker.batch_size`: number of messages the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed processes together in one batch.
- New error code PQ-E1176 (INGRESS_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `coordinator.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.
- New option `spool.log_level`: log verbosity of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.
- New option `compactor.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `broker.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues starts throttling.
- New option `coordinator.enabled`: turns the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers on or off.
- New option `compactor.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
compactor.worker_threads (PaderQueue 3.x) (config, PaderQueue 3.x)
# `compactor.worker_threads` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of worker threads used by the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | compactor |
| Unit | threads |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `compactor.worker_threads` only if you observe problems with the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
worker_threads = 8
```

PQ-E2771 DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT (error, PaderQueue 4.x)
# PQ-E2771 DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: operation timeout`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
An operation of the dlq did not complete within the configured timeout.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check network latency and load on the involved nodes. For slow but healthy clusters, increase `dlq.timeout_ms`.
PaderQueue 1.1 release notes (changelog, PaderQueue 1.1)
# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features
- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.
- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `snapshotter.enabled`: turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.
- New option `auth.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the authentication module that validates client tokens waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.
- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

# PQ-E3221 BROKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `broker: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the broker is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `broker.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (error, PaderQueue 4.x)
# PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.2

## What it means
The scheduler refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `scheduler.max_connections`.

- `acktracker.batch_size`
- `acktracker.interval_s`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

- New option `partitioner.log_level`: log verbosity of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.
- New option `quota.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E4157 (REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

Time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

| Default | `30000` |

```toml
[dlq]

```

PaderQueue 2.1 release notes (changelog, PaderQueue 2.1)
`auth.log_level`: log verbosity of the authentication module that validates client tokens. - New option `scheduler.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

- New option `broker.batch_size`: number of messages the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues processes together in one batch.

PQ-E2470 SNAPSHOTTER_COMPONENT_DISABLED (error, PaderQueue 4.x)
# PQ-E2470 SNAPSHOTTER_COMPONENT_DISABLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `snapshotter: component disabled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
A request needed the snapshotter, but the snapshotter is switched off.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `snapshotter.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

PQ-E4708 SCHEDULER_THROTTLED (error, PaderQueue 4.x)
# PQ-E4708 SCHEDULER_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: throttled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `scheduler.threshold_percent`.

**Impact:** Failed requests in `search-indexer`

showed error PQ-E2051 repeatedly.

- T+10: On-call engineer found PQ-E2051 in the broker logs.
- T+20: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+40: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a failing disk on one node.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2051.
- Add an alert for this error code.

PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (error, PaderQueue 4.x)
# PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.2

## What it means
The scheduler refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `scheduler.max_connections`.

5 (COORDINATOR_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message. - New option `compactor.log_level`: log verbosity of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

- New option `partitioner.compression`: compression codec that the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written uses for stored or transferred data.

**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The replicator refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

- Too small limits for the current load

Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `replicator.max_connections`.

The scheduler is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `scheduler.threshold_percent`.

If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

PaderQueue 2.2 release notes (changelog, PaderQueue 2.2)
# PaderQueue 2.2 release notes

Released on 2022-12-12.

## New features
- New option `broker.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `acktracker.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New error code PQ-E4371 (ACKTRACKER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4711 (ACKTRACKER_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New option `snapshotter.log_level`: log verbosity of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.
- New error code PQ-E3828 (METRICS_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3239 (QUOTA_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `coordinator.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers starts throttling.
- New option `coordinator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.

- New error code PQ-E3575 (COORDINATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4426 (SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (error, PaderQueue 4.x)
# PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.2

## What it means
The scheduler refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `scheduler.max_connections`.

showed error PQ-E3792 repeatedly.

- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+52: On-call engineer found PQ-E3792 in the broker logs.
- T+105: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+210: Service recovered.

The immediate trigger was a configuration change during a deployment.

# PQ-E4020 SPOOL_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
Two nodes of the spool use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Set `spool.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

PaderQueue 3.1 release notes (changelog, PaderQueue 3.1)
# PaderQueue 3.1 release notes

Released on 2024-01-15.

## New features
- New option `acktracker.batch_size`: number of messages the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed processes together in one batch.
- New error code PQ-E1176 (INGRESS_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `coordinator.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.
- New option `spool.log_level`: log verbosity of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.
- New option `compactor.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `broker.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues starts throttling.
- New option `coordinator.enabled`: turns the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers on or off.
- New option `compactor.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `scheduler.threshold_percent`.

# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features
- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.
- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `snapshotter.enabled`: turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.
- New option `auth.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the authentication module that validates client tokens waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.
- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

# `partitioner.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | partitioner |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `partitioner.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
```

# `acktracker.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `128` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | connections |

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.max_connections` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

```toml
[acktracker]
max_connections = 128
```

**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.
